summary: A quotation set apart from the text, with its author and source when it has them.
use: A testimonial, a cited passage, or a pull quote from the page itself. For a short quote in a sentence, use <q> in prose.

author.description: Who said it. Leave it out for a pull quote from the page's own text.

source.description: The work it's from, cited by title.

cite.description: Where the quote can be found.
